info.title: publish_estimate
info.description: Assembles the estimate and writes the package JSON plus the Excel / Word / PowerPoint exports to blob storage (answers/estimate/latest.*), so the assessment dashboard web app on the Container App can serve it. Call after the other tools; then point the user at the Container App's /dashboard URL.

post.summary: Publish the estimate to the assessment dashboard
post.description: Pass the assemble_estimate result as {"package": {...}}, or the assemble_estimate inputs directly. Writes latest.json + latest.xlsx/docx/pptx to answers/estimate/ and returns what was written.

engagement.description: Engagement id as '<customer>/<project>' (lowercase, [a-z0-9-] per segment). Scopes the data and where the deliverables are written. Omit only for the legacy single-estate flow (defaults to '_default_/_default_').

build_poe.description: When true, also start the Azure Pricing Calculator POE run for this engagement right after publishing (equivalent to calling build_calculator_estimate). Best-effort — publishing still succeeds if the POE run can't be queued. The POE takes a few minutes; poll get_calculator_estimate or watch the dashboard card.

include_dr_compute.description: Only used with build_poe: price standing warm-standby DR compute in the calculator POE (default false — DR runs on failover only).

poe.description: Present when build_poe was set: {status:'building', spec_line_count, internal_monthly_estimate} once the calculator run is queued, or {status:'skipped', reason} if it couldn't start.
